author: (R. Robertson, 1958)

note.en: A pheasant snail under 1 cm that lives on seagrass blades. The local record is from the Puerto Viejo pier at 3 m[^1]. Too small to notice.
note.es: Un caracol faisán de menos de 1 cm que vive sobre hojas de pasto marino. El registro local es del muelle de Puerto Viejo a 3 m[^1]. Demasiado pequeño para notarlo.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Record from the Puerto Viejo pier, 1998.
